tei:div.tei:p: mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa steng gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+mo'i phreng*/ /zhing la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa 'og gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng*/ /'du la sogs par dpa' bo dpa' mo gnyis med rol/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi'i mtshams rnams su/ khwa gdong la sogs ma mo yid 'phrog gzugs gnyis ldan// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang*/ /yang dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dbang po sogs/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal med khang*/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas ni mdzes par rab tu brgyan gyur pa'i/ /mu tig dra ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyang*/ /bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad+ma chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs/ /ri dwags dang bcas mdzes pa'i ba dan bcu drug legs 'phyar zhing*/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dag las chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog

| bkra shis gang zhig yongs su bskor ba'i dur khrod brgyad rnams su/ / phyogs skyong brgyad dang shing chen brgyad ni rab tu gnas pa la/ /gdong brnyan dang ldan zhing skyong brgyad ni nye bar gnas gyur pa'i/ /bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me brgyad rab tu 'bar gyur zhing*/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus gyur la/ /dga' bo la sogs klu chen brgyad ni kun nas gnas gyur pa'i | | bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu chen brgyad 'bab cing*/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gang*/ /sha za srin po 'byung po'i tshogs kyis nye bar bsten pa yin/ /bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog bkra shis gang zhig rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur/ /rdo rje bla res kun nas bris shing mda' yi dra bar ldan/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i phreng bas kun nas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bden pa des ni bde ba mchog la gnas rnams bkra shis shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ kha che'i yul du byung zhing dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// /kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba zhu byas tshul khrims bkra shis kyis bsgyur ba'o/ / 'di'i tshig rkang ma mnyam pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhu dag dang srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa kha skong ba ni 'phags pas bgyis so// //༄༅/ /bde mchog gi bkra shis bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba/ /ha ha'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo mdzad cing*// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bdud dpung nges 'joms pa'i/ /bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig

/e bam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba bde ba'i sku/ /ā li kā li rol pa'i gsung mnga' zhing*/ /hūm̐ gi ngo bor son pa'i thugs ldan pa/ /he ru ka dpal bkra shis sbyin gyur cig /sprul pa du ma'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /spro dang bsdu dang yongs su sgyur mdzad cing*/ /spros dang spros med bdag nyid rgyal ba yis/ /bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /rgyal bu jim gyim la'o// //༄༅/ /yang bkra shis bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma la na mo/ dpal mchog bde chen 'gyur med rtag pa'i sku/ /dpal chen rdo rje phag mos nyer 'khril ba'i/ /dpal ldan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis/ /dpal mo khyod ni rtag tu skyong gyur cig /go go can la'o// //a bhi dha na'i le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa las/ thog ma bar dang ma tha mar ni/ / dam tshig nyams pa bskang ba dang*/ /dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /'khor lo dag ni bstan pa'i phyir/ /yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga bān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca he ru ko bha ba | ma hā sa ma ya sa twa a hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'byung ngo*// //༄༅/ /phag mo ¡Ã lha so bdun ma'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sngon 'byung ma'i ) mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo la btud nas/ /de yi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /sgrub thabs gsal bar bshad par bya/ /'di nyid dam yab kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ rdo rje phag mo lha sum cu so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la ci bde bar 'dug nas/

skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas la | bdud rtsi myangs nas rang skad cig gis rdo rje phag mor dmigs pa'i snying gi nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po las 'od 'phros pas | rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor bla ma rigs bdag gi rnam pas gtso mo'i dbur brgyan pa spyan drangs pa la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dang | na maḥshrī badz+ra bā ra hī maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥs phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badz+ra bā ra hī maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba yo gi nī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tshas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil/ puṣ+paṃ gyis me tog nghū paṃ gyis bdug spos/ dī paṃ gyis mar me/ gan+dhaṃ gyis dri/ nai wi d+yes zhal zas/ shap+tas rol mo phul nas/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa ma lus pa/ khyed rnams kun gyi spyan sngar so sor bshags par bgyi/ /bla ma la sogs rnams kyis bsod nams bgyis pa gang*/ /de rnams ma lus kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bya ba byas pa byed par 'gyur ba'i gang zag rnams/ /dge ba des ni sems can ma lus rgyal bar smon | | dkon mchog gsum la nges par yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba bde la dgod phyir chos kyi rgyal por gyur/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi lam la yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /mgon po bzhes shig bdag gi lus nyid dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum brjod nas sems can thams cad bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa dang phrad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang bral ba dang*/ bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ yid kun nas snyoms par bsgom pa ni btang snyoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar dmigs nas oṃ swa bhā wa shung+nghaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shung+ngho3 haṃ/ zhes pa dang sgyu ma tsam du'ang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid bsgoms la/

oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las steng dang shar du khwa gdong ma gnyis dang*/ 'og dang nub tu khyi gdong ma gnyis dang bcas pa'i sgo mtshams ma rnams shar nas rim pa dang shar lho nas rim pa las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis phyogs bcur spro bar bsam/ ngag tu zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyi rkang pa re re brjod/ lus kyis g.yon pa'i se gol brdabs pa rnams sbyar zhing*/ bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam mo/ /yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ ra ba dang dra ba dang gur dang*/ bla re dang mda'i dra ba dang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rnams su rim pa bzhin gyur par bsam mo/ /lus kyis g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor la se gol brdab/ ngag tu oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐ om̐ badz+ra pañja ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dzā la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros pa lag pa g.yas par gtad de/ rang rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa du ma dang bcas pa'i pho nya rnams spros pas phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i bgegs rnams bkug dkar po'i phyogs rnams byang chub kyi lam la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams 'obs kyi phyi rol gyi kha khyer la gnas pa'i spyi bor phur bus btab par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+tān phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nan kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod do/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs nas rdul du brlag par bsam zhing*/ oṃ muṅga ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi sdig pa sbyangs nas rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /de'i steng du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gdengs kha gyen la phyogs pa'i nang du yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sum̐ las ri rab/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin/ bang rim bzhi pa lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ om̐ las rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka'i om̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag par byas/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ dkar po | ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ mda' yab dang rin po che'i shar bu dang bcas pa las dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rtsig pa'i 'og 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i phyogs re rer lha mo bzhi bzhis mchod rdzas du ma 'dzin pa 'khod pa/ sgo'i steng gi thad so bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang gdugs dang bcas pa nang gi phyogs bzhi'i lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang | nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ mtshams bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis te/ bum pa brgyad kyis mdzes par byas shing ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i gdung mig mangs ris su bres pas 'dod yon gyi bar non pa/ dbus kyi phubs ni gong ma gong mas phubs pa'i phyir 'og ma 'og mas ma phubs pa'o/ /de'i nang du mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhi gnas te/ phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo dkar po/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/

ka ba dang gdung dang | thog phubs can/ bar ma gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang gdung dang*/ thog phubs can/ nang ma thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang rtsibs brgyad pa 'og gzhi'i kha dog sngon po'o/ /lte ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gis mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa/ dbus byur bur gyur pa'i rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis brgyan pa ste dwangs shing sgrib pa med la 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'khrugs pa'o/ /lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun du/ nyi ma dang dbus su 'jigs byed dang*/ dus mtshan dang*/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la ro'i gdan bsam mo/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du/ shar du gtum drag byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ srin por mun pa mi bzad pa/ rlung du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod do/ /de nyid kyi rim pas brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/ chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te/ phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ sprin chen po brgyad/ chu chen po brgyad/ me chen po brgyad/ mchod rten chen po brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ ce spyang la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod kyis bskor bar bsam mo/ /de nas gdan rnams kyi steng du ā li phrag gnyis gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes su mos pa'i steng du ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa'i kā li phrag gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su bsams nas/

dbus kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du bam̐ dmar po dang | gzhan rnams la rim pa bzhin/ ḍām̐ lām̐ kham̐ rum̐/ pum̐ dzam̐ auṃ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· um̐ ) am̐ gam̐ rām̐ de ྃmām̐/ kām̐ om̐ triṃ kom̐ kam̐ lam̐ kām̐ hi/ྃ pre ྃgṛṃ sauṃ sum̐ nam̐ siṃ mam̐ kum̐/ kam̐ um̐ sham̐ sum̐ dam̐ dum̐ dam̐ mam̐/ rnams so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su bsams nas so so'i gnas su gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes su bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lha'i sku rnams chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te dbus su rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug thur du 'dzin zhing g.yon pa khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa gyen du bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon pa la dril bu dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru khur zhing zhabs g.yon pa bskum pas 'jigs byed dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan zhing*/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra nag po sil mar gyur pa/ shin tu mdzes shing sgeg la cung zad khro ba'i nyams can du bsam mo/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ byang du lā mā ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ste/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o | | shar rtsibs pul+lī ra mā la yar rab tu gtum mo/ /byang dzā lan+dha rar gtum pa'i m-ig can ma/ nub au ḍ+yan du 'od ldan ma/ lho arbu dar sna chen ma/ shar lho go dā wa rīr brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub rā me shwa rar mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de wī ko ṭar laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar mā la war shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o | | de'i phyir rol gyi shar kā ma rū par ai rā ba tī/ byang o trer 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub tri sha ku nar rlung gi shugs can ma/

lho ko sa lar chang 'thung ma | shar lho ka liṃ gar sh+yā ma de wī/ lho nub laṃ bā kar shin tu bzang mo/ /nub byang kāñcir rta rna ma/ byang shar hi mā la yar kha gā na na ste gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyir rol gyi shar pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang gṛ ha de bar khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ nub sau rāṣ+tar shauṇ+ḍi nī/ lho su war+ṇa dwī par 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sid+dhur stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma ror 'khor los sgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tār brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma/ lho sgor phag gdong ma rnams phyogs kyi mdog can/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang*/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs shing rgyan dang nyams thams cad ni rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa ste 'on kyang sgo mtshams ma rnams ni yi dwags kyi gdan la bzhugs shing drag cing gtum pa'i gzugs can no/ /de nas lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa ni lā mā'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o

| | sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni wī ra ma ti'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni e rā wa tī'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed ma'o/ / brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs ma'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni shin tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta rna ma ma'o | | brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni kha gā na na'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'o/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni chang 'tshong ma'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin du dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni bya rog gi gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug pa'i gdong can ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed par byed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/

/zhes dag pa rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de nas snying gar pam̐ dang phyogs bzhir ḍam̐ lam̐ kham̐ rum̐/ mtshams su rlung sems 'dres pa'i rtsa bzhi dang*/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i lus kyi cha shas su/ pu dzā u a go rā de mā | kā o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gṛ sau su nā si ma ku/ kha lte ba mtshan ma bshang lam mdzod spu mig rna ba sna rnams la/ kām̐ um̐ sham̐ sum̐ dam̐ dum̐ dam̐ mam̐/ rnams skad cig gis lha rnams su gyur nas rim gyis gsal gdab ste/ lte bar rdo rje phag mo/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du lā mā/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ lhor gzugs can ma mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bzhi ste bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o | | spyi bo pul+lī ra mā la yar rab tu gtum mo'o/ /spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha rar gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa au ḍ+yan du 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu dar sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go dā wa rīr brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin phrag rā me shwa rir mi'u thung ma/ mig de wi ko ṭar laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa mā la war shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /mchan khung kā ma rū par ai rā ba tī/ nu ma o trer 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner rlung gi shugs can ma/ ko sa lar chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo*// kha ka liṅgar sh+yā ma de wī/ mgrin pa lam+ba kar shin tu bzang mo ste tshan+do ha/ snying kāñcir rta rna ma/ mdom bar hi ma la yar kha gā na na ste nye ba'i tshan+do ha gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ 'og sgo gṛ ha de war khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ste 'du ba/ brla sau rāṣ+tar shauṇ+ḍi nī/ byin pa su war+ṇa dwī par 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ /sor mo na ga rar shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong sin+dhur stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bo ma ror 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo ku lu tar brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod rnams sku'i 'khor lo sa bcu rnam par dag pa'o/

kha dang lto ba la sogs pa yi ge brgyad rim pa bzhin khwa gdong*/ 'ug gdong*/ khyi gdong*/ phag gdong*/ gshin rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma rnams su gsal bar lta'o/ /de nas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du bdag gyur par bsam zhing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra shung+nghaḥsarba dhar+m+māḥbadz+ra shung+ngho3 haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas lha rnams kyi lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan bsams pa'i steng du lte bar om̐ bam̐ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yom̐ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ kha la hri ྃmam̐ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bor hre ྃhri ྃskyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha'i go cha rnams bkod nas/ lus kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su bskor/ ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod/ sems kyis snying ga'i bam̐ gyi 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ snga ma ltar mchod/ dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang*/ bcing pa dang dbang du byas par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.oṃ yo ga shung+nghaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/ /yang snga ma bzhin dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing spyi bo nas ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rdo rje phag mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa lce la myangs pas lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i char mngon par phab par bsam zhing*/ snga ma ltar mchod nas lha mo de dag nyid kyis bstod par bsam zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun du rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug pa/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /gtso mo 'ba' zhig bsgom pa dang*/ lha lnga ma dang*/ lha bcu gsum ma bsgom pa'i tshul yang 'dis shes par 'gyur te/ 'on kyang gtso mo 'ba' zhig bsgom pa ni gzhal yas khang med par dur khrod kyi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum snod dang bcas pa thams cad dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bsdu/ de nas rim pa bzhin sku dang gsung dang thugs dang bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ de'ang rang gi snying gar bsdus nas/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mor dmigs pa'i spyi bo dang*/ spyi gtsug la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su khams byang chub kyis sems las grub pa'i pu dzā la sogs pa'i yi ger bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gnas pa dmigs pa rnams lte ba'i gtum mo'i me a shad kyi rnam pa lta bu'i 'od kyis gdungs pas khams bdud rtsi de dag rgyas shing cung zad bzhu ba'i rgyun lte ba'i gnas su babs pas me'i nus pa cher 'phel zhing khams kyis lus thams cad khengs pa la sems gtad de rlung kha sbyor du bya'o/

/de ltar bsgoms pas bde ba dang ye shes 'bar bar 'gyur te yi ge'i rnal 'byor ro/ /yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dmigs pa'i lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du bam̐ gyi yi ge bsams nas | rang gi sku stod nyi ma/ sku smad zla ba/ nyi zla bam̐ la bsdu/ bam̐ gyi'ang khog pa mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la bsdus nas nā da shin tu phra ba gsal ba/ mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin du dmigs te sems bzung*/ yang nā da'ang mched cing gsal bar gyur pa las thig le dang klad kor dang*/ bam̐ dang*/ nyi zla kha sbyor bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang*/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snod bcud dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs pa la sems bzung*/ de ltar bsdu ba dang*/ spro ba'i rnal 'byor rgyun tu bsgoms pas gsal ba dang*/ stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur te dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ / yang nā da'i bar du bsdu ba snga ma ltar byas nas nā da'ang mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las sems mnyam par bzhag go /de la goms pas spros pa dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur te dmigs pa med pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pa'i snang ba la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs nas lha rnams ky-i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang rang gi sa bon bsams pa'i mtha' mar/ rang rang gi sngags g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas/ byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ om̐ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra wā ra hī baṃ/ ār+yā pa ra dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bid+ye shwa ri sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badz+re badz+rā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi/

sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi/ kro nghe ka rā li ni trā sa ni/ mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo hā ni/ badz+ra wā rā hi/ ma hā yo gi nī/ kā me shwa ri kha ge tad+ya thā/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge ha na ha na prā ṇāṃ/ ki ྃk-i ni/ kh-i ྃkhi ni/ dhu na nghu na badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + kha ḍā ga ) nghā ri ṇi/ ma hā pi si ta māṃ sa a sha ni/ mā nu ¡Ã ṣa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ṣān+t+ra ga ) / an+t+ra prā bṛ ti/ sān+ni dh+ya na ra si ra/ mā lā gran+thi ta/ nghā ri ṇi sum+bha ni/ sum+bhe ha na ha na pra ṇā na/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + sarba pā pa satwa nāṃ/ ) sarba pa shu bā nāṃ/ mahā mān+sa ts+tshe da ni kro ngha mūr+t+te daṃṣ+t+rā ka rā lī ni/ ma hā mu dre | shrī he ru ka de wa s+ya/ a gra ma hi/ ṣi sa ha sra shi re sa ha sra bā ha be sha ta sa ha sra a na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se dz+wā la mu khi piṅga la la tsa ne badz+ra shā rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ne mi li te mi li te he he hūm̐ hūm̐ kha kha nghu nghu/ nghu ru nghu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñca muñca/ a dwai te/ ma hā yo gi nī/ pa ṭhe ta sidhe/ dreṃ ngheṃ dreṃ ngheṃ/ graṃ graṃ he he/ ha ha bhī me/ ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ hā hā ho ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lo kya/ bi nā sha ni/ sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi ta thā ga ta/ pa ri wā re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ siṃ ha rū pe kha/ ga dza rū pe gaḥtrai lo kya/ u da re ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ma hā ) sa mu dra/ me kha le/ gra sa gra sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ wī ra dwai te hūm̐ hūm̐/ hāḥ hāḥm hā pa shu mo ha ni/ ma hā yo gwi shwa ri/ twaṃ ḍā ki nī/ sarba lo kā nāṃ/ ban+dha ni sa d+yaḥ pra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhū ta trā sa ni ma hā bī re pa ra ma sid+dhe yo gī shwa ri phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pa ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'o// oṃ ka ra ka ra pra tsaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha pra bhā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ma hā nā se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya bī ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ kharba rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥ laṃ ki shwa rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ dru mats+tsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa e rā wa tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha ma hā bhai ra wi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa wā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi ra an+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ bi ne su rā bhak+ṣī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gri h+na gri h+na sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzāṃ ga sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya/ sh+ya ma de wī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a kaḍ+ḍha ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + ya ) a kaḍ+ḍha ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + ya ) su bha dre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ ha ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ga ā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hām̐ hām̐ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ shauṇ+ḍi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ tsakra warmi ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li su bī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li ma hā ba le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li tsakra warti nā ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li ma hā bīr+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ u lū kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sū ka rā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā dhi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ya ma dū ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+t+rī ṇā+e ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyi sngags te de dag gang mos pa la ci nus pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma suṃ bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me'i steng du āḥlas thod pa yangs pa'i nang du shar lho nub byang dbus su go ku da ha na las ba lang khyi rta glang po che mi ste sha lnga dang*/ de'i steng du shar dbus nub byang lhor/ bi mu shu ma ra las dri chen/ dri chu/ byang sems

| klad pa/ rak+ta ste/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ de'i steng du dbus dang shar nas g.yas skor gyis hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥrnams chos kyi dbyings/ me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid | so sor rtog pa/ bya ba grub pa ste ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bsam/ de'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin om̐ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba'o/ /de'i steng du byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mgo thur du lta ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsams nas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos nas me sbar/ des sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ye shes lnga bzhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ om̐ dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las byung ba'i 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rnam par bkug nas gtor ma la thim/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga om̐ dang bcas pa lhung nas thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dmigs la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod cing byin gyi brlab bo/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha sum cu so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs la/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ dur khrod kyi bdag po phyogs skyong dang bcas thams cad bstim nas lag pa gnyis nyi zlar bsgoms pa'i thal mo gnyis la ā li kā li gnyis bkod nas thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥpa ra s+pha ra/ a nu ga ta sarba r+harmāḥ.a d+yan+ta a nu ga ta sarba dharmā/ a ti ta a nu pra be sha ya sarba dharmā hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas thabs dang shes rab kyi lag par byin gyis brlabs pa kha phye ba'i steng du gtor ma bzhag pa bstabs par bsam zhing*/

oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan lnga dang rje btsun ma'i yang snying la sogs pa so so'i sngags kyi 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa un+mā da/ a pa smā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi ma pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+taṃ/ bhuñja tha dzi gha tha/ pi wa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kar+t+ta/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaswā hā/ zhes pa gsum gyis dur khrod na gnas pa rnams la phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra bā ra hī baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+yā pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wā he ma hā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+rā sa ne/ a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wā sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ om̐ na ¡Ã maḥ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bi ṣa ) sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ka rā li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ¡Ã trā sa ni ( ¡¶ zha ¡· na maḥsan+t+ra sha ni ) mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā ra hī ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bstod nas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang | | gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang | | 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang | | sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang | | ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/ 'dir gshegs pa dag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol | | srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang | | gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams rgyas zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ / yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin las bcol nas rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas byin dbab cing bkra shis par bya'o/ /gtor ma'o | | zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i khrod na lus kyi lha rnams gsal bar dmigs nas/ khyad par du nang gi gtso mo'i spyi bor bla ma rigs bdag gi gtso bor bzhugs par bsam/ de nas lag pa'i mchod pas lag pa'i lha tshim par byas nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs/ kha hom khung*/ kha zas bsreg rdzas su bsams la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ shin tu zhen par mi bya bar bdud rtsi'i ro myang zhing bza'o/

/lhag ma oṃ uts+tshi ṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes pas lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /nyal ba'i tshe rdzogs rim gyi skabs ltar lha rnams bsdus nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo// ldang ba'i tshe gong du bshad pa ltar 'od gsal las lha'i sku zung 'jug tu ldang ngo*/ khrus kyi tshe ting nge 'dzin gong gi dbang bskur ba dang 'dra la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing khrus byas pas sdig pa dang dri ma thams cad dag par bsam mo/ / mthar dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang gi lus kyi om̐ bam̐ la sogs pa'i dpa' mo dang pu dzā la sogs pa so so'i sngags brjod pas lha rnams so so'i gnas su thim pas bdag nyid bsrungs nas sum+bha'i sngags lan gnyis kyis phyogs mtshams rnams bcings la/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje phag mo'i skur bsam ste/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags su bsgoms la yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du bsams la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas lhas lha mchod par bsam zhing yul rnams la sdang zhen med par longs spyad do/ /de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ yan lag gi rnal 'byor la shin tu goms pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin spyod pas brtan par byas pas thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyis yid bde bar byas nas/ sa dang lam thams cad bgrod de/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang | rdo rje phag mo/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ yul ba ren+d+ra'i rnal 'byor pa bi rū pa/ yul ra ḍa'i slob dpon u ma pa ta ¡Ã ha dh-i ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· da dha ) / shān+ta gup+ta | tsan+d+ra kīrti/ wā gī shwa ra gup+ta/ bla ma rwa lo ts+tsha ba chos rab/

rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ slob dpon rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje/ dge slong 'phags pa rnams so/ /de ltar lung don man ngag gis brgyan pa'i/ /sgrub thabs go go can gyis rab bskul nas/ /'phags pas sbyar ba'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun/ / rdo rje phag mo'i go 'phang thob par shog /rdo rje phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi rjais su 'brang ba slob dpon shrī u ma pa ¡Ã ta ha dhis ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· ti dha tas ) mdzad pa'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas chu pho sprail gyi lo dgun zla 'bring po'i yar gyi ngo la shing kun gyi mkhar du sbyar ¡Ã ba'o/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// ) // ༄༅/ /na ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bskyed dang rol pa'i yum gyur pa/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mar btud nas/ /de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la kha nub phyogs su bltas nas ci bde bar 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum skyabs su song nas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam mo/ /de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang ma bral na bdag gi don grub snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde sdug med pa'i ngang du sems snyoms par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/

de nas bdag gi spyi bor ¡Ã bla ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nam mkha' la rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la rang gi bla ma dam pa sku dar la bab pa rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa bzhugs pa / ) bsgoms la/ dus gsum gy-i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod cing mos gus drag po byas pas bla ma rang gi lus la thim pas/ snying gi nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar bam̐ ¡Ã las ( ¡¶ zha ¡· la oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs nas swā hā'i bar ) sngags kyi phreng ¡Ã bas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· kha dog dmar pos g.yon du ) bskor bar dmigs nas/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ sems can thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur te/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rang la thim pas rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma | zhal gyen du phyogs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍa ma ru dang dril bu 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom | de'i lte bar om̐ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hri ྃmaṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mgor hreṃ hri ྃser mo skyod byed ma

| spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka rnams su bsams la/ de'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shud+dha:sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bsams nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul gsum las/ bha ga'i nang du dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du myur du 'khor ba gcig bsams nas/ de la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la/ rlung kha sbyor bsgaums pas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i steng gi nam mkhar dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad yid mnyam par bzhag pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang stong shas che na bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing | bde shas che na stong pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la/ zung du chud par gyur na dga' ba 'khyil pa de nyid snying ga'i bam̐ la bstim ste/ mnyam par bzhag par bya'o | | rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// //sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang | dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas de dag gi ye shes bdag gi rgyud la zhugs pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas par bya'o// gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ sha chang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma/

om̐ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ thod pa chen po sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la phaiṃ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug pa'i/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang

| | des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas/ /bden pa des ni lha mo de dag rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas/ gsol ba btab nas ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· pas ) ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub gnang bar bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang rnal 'byor mar dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du snying gar bla ma dang*/ ¡Ã sangs rgyas dang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dkon mchog gsum la ) byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang*/ lto bar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + chos skyong dang ) 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad dmigs nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa bsgoms pa'i lte bar/ om̐ bam̐ mdun phyogs nas brtsams pa'i 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin ham̐ yom̐ hri ྃmam̐ hreṃ hri ྃhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bkod pa rnams dpa' mo drug tu dmigs pa la mchod par bsam zhing*/ thog mar zhu ba'i rdzas dang*/ de nas gong bu'i rdzas kyis mchod pas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnye'o/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pas dpral pa/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg pas | dpa' mo de rnams rang gi lus la thim par bsams nas lag pa g.yon pas thog mar phud kyis bla ma dang yi dam la mchod la/ de nas kha hom khung du bsams la phul bas lus kyi lha thams cad mnyes par bsam zhing bza'a'o/ / de nas lhag ma om̐ uts+tshi ṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no/ /spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad mchod pa'i lha mor dmigs pa rnams kyis 'dod yon gyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba med par ci bde bar spyod do/ /nyal ba'i tshe/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyi rol gyi 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim/

rang gi lus kyang snying ga'i bam̐ la thim/ bam̐ stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /ldang ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs nas ldang bar bya'o/ /de ltar yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la rtag tu gnas na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis rjes su bzung nas mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang myur du thob ste/ go 'phang de la brten nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dngos grub kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /gsung rab zab mo'i snying po'i tshul/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dad ldan shes rab rab gsal ba/ /go go can gyis gsol btab nas/ /lung dang man ngag dang ldan pa/ /sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun | | bde ba'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur nas/ /mkha' spyod mchog gis rol gyur cig /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i man ngag dpal sa skya pa las brgyud pa 'di ni dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas sa mo sbrul gyi lo gdu bu'i zla ¡Ã ba la shang tor ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ba'i tshes gcig la rgyal po'i pho brang du ) sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /nā ro mkha' spyod sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cigasdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig dga' ba dang bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du yi ge bam̐ dmar mo bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa sbyangs/

phyir 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus bam̐ la thim pa las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bzhengs pa'i zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas gṛ gug thur du 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa steng du phyogs par bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon pa la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khur ba la ḍa ma ru btags pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa dbu skra nag po sil mar gyur pa/ spyan gsum pa/ shin tu mdzes pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang la bstim/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam | de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bam̐ gyi tha ma sngags kyis bskor bas bdag gi sdig pa dang nad thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaswā hā/ ) sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla'o/ /gtor ma om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsum mam/ bdun gyis phul la 'dod pa'i gsol ba gdab/

badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi lus kyi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod do/ /nub mor nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo/ /ldang ba'i tshe lha'i skur ldang ngo*/ /spyod lam thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o/ /de ltar rtag tu yi dam du byas na/ ring por mi thogs par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /dpal nā ro ta pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'i mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// //༄༅/ /tshogs 'khor bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bla ma dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes kyi/ / sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba/ /mkha' spyod ma dpal la btud de/ /de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad/ /dam tshig dang ldan pa 'dir zhugs shing rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i gang zag gis/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i dus kyi tshe/ dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ yo byad rnams bsogs nas/ dmar gtor gcig om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gri h+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bgegs thams cad la byin nas bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las rtsom pa la bar du gcod pa ma byed par dengs shig ces pa dang sum+bha ni brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskrad do/ /de nas las kyi slob mas zhu phul ba dang*/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ¡Ã

mar dmigs nas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṅga 'dzin par bsgoms la/ ) / lag pa g.yon pa'i se gol shar nas phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ shar lho nas mtshams g.yas skor du brdab cing*/ sum bha'i sngags rkang pa re re brjod pas bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri zhing 'di'i sngags kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi des lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun gtor zhing mnye ba dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du thig le bkod ¡Ã pas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· la oṃ a hūm̐ brjod ) rang gi lus dag par byas nas gnas dang phyi'i mchod pa rnams la gtor te/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang bcas par dmigs nas om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yi ge brgya pa brjod pas sdig pa sbyangs nas/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin mngon par rtogs pa bsgoms te/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa zhig bya'o/ /de nas yang nang mchod kyis mchod rdzas rnams la gtor zhing sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs | stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon la sogs pa lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med par bskyed nas/ so sor sngags dang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun na dmigs pa'i rten yod dam med kyang rung ste/ skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu bskyed nas/ dpa' mo'i go cha drug bkod de/

ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas nas/ de'i mtha' mar rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad kyis gang bar bsgoms nas/ de rnams mchod par bsam zhing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī zhes kun la sbyar nas/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ye ) hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ye ) swā hās zhabs bsil | badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra nghū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai bid+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas | badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo dbul/ de nas dngos su 'byor pa dang*/ yid kyis sprul pa'i 'dod yon lngas mchod par bsam zhing*/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis gzugs/ shab+da kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis sgra/ gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis ro/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis reg bya dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas nang gi mchod pa thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa rnams la dbul te/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + slob dpon ) rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ an+tar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa/ bla ma mal/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma chos kyi rje ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta ) / zhes pa'i mtshan rnams kyi mthar/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbul/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mchod nas/ rang gi lce rtse/ dpral ba | mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su reg la rang gi lus kyi lha rnams mchod de/

chos skyong srung ma dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'gro ba ri drug gi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + bar gyi ) sems can rnams la'ang sbyin no/ /de nas rang gi lce la reg pas bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + dkyil 'khor gyi ) lha rnams mnyes nas bzhad pa'i dbyangs sngags kyi sgrar grags par bsam zhing*/ de nyid kyi sngags ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + oṃ gsum ma ) lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin gyis brlab dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis brlab dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ phyag rgya'i mthu dang | bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa | bla ma dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la se gol brdab bo/ /yang snying gar bcas la/ om̐ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta/ ā brta ho/ na mas+sa man+ta bung+nghā nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu/ ā kā sha ya/ sa man+ta maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shung+ngha le/ maṇ+ḍal le ma ma pra ṇi nghi/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na/ ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+ta ban+dha swas+thā na | ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas bdag pos ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + yongs su ) ma bzung ba dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma sbyangs la sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba'i cho gas dang po rnal 'byor ma dang*/

gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs kyi phud bla ma dang lha rnams la 'bul zhing*/ gtor ma la'ang so so'i sngags brjod pas phul nas/ dam tshig drangs te phud nang mchod kyi skabs ltar mchod nas lag pa'i mchod pa byas la/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ g.yon gyi kun tu spyod pa'i tshul gyis zhen pa med cing tshim par longs spyad do/ /bar skabs su phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas/ g.yengs bar mi 'gyur ba'i glu dang*/ gar dang | rol mo'i sgras mchod par bya'o/ /dus thams cad du bdag dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ rang gis brjod pa dang phyi rol na grags pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i sngags dang*/ sems kyi bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ phyi nang gi nyams su myong ba'i bde ba thams cad kyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mchod par bsam zhing yang nas yang du lha'i rnam pa gsal gdab par bya'o/ /de nas longs spyad pas tshim pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ om̐ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis byin nas/ rdo rje'i glu blangs la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i pad+ma la ni rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/ /bkra shis des ni bde ba mchog gnas pa yi bkra shis shog / ces brjod nas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ lha mo tshad ma la sogs pa bden pa'i stobs kyang lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gis lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa la sogs pa'i smon lam btab nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos la/ med na gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa la/ om̐ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gtor ma rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bskyal nas/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ go cha drug gis kyang rgyas btab la/ nyal ba'am/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyis chos bzhin du gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni/ sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa 'dag pa dang*/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs dam skong zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + thams cad ) myur du rdzogs pa'o/ /chos tshul 'di ni 'phags pa yis/ /bsdebs nas go go che la phul | | dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun/ /tshogs gnyis dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig | dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga'i rim pa 'di ni/ dad pa dang shes rab dang ldan pa go go chen zhes bya bas bskul nas/ chos rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin du lcags pho rta'i lo dbyu gu'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la shang tor bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /sbyin sreg bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir | sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thab khung du bud shing legs par brtsigs la/ g.yon phyogs su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dmar gtor gsum bsham/ g.yas su yam shing dang*/ mar khu dang*/ chang bzang po la bdud rtsi sbyar ba dang*/ sha lnga tshang ba dang*/ shing gang yang rung ba'i dum bu gtubs pa dang*/ til dang*/ zho dang | 'o ma/ mar/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ dūr ba dang*/ ku sha rnams dgod/ rang kha shar du bstan nas 'dug pa'i mdun du | nang mchod rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs dang bcas pa bzhag nas/ bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa rdzogs par byas la/ thab dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la nang mchod nas gtor zhing*/ sum+bha'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bskyed nas | hūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams om̐ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dang*/

bsreg rdzas dpag tu med par bskyed la/ om̐ ā:hūm̐ dang so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo | | de nas oṃ ag+na ye dzā la ram̐ zhes brjod cing me spar nas de'i dbus su ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pa bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang po dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i gun+dhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ khri snyan sa le'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ dar dmar mo'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams pa'i dpral bar om̐/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dmigs nas/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par bstim mo | | de nas yang 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs la mchod nas | 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas de yi ljags las 'od zer byung ba'i nang nas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing lan bdun phul nas/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra d+dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri mchog badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi rol mo ) dbul lo | | de nas 'bar ba'i me la yam shing dang*/

zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag dang*/ dūr ba dang ku sha spyi gtsug tu 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ gong gi sngags nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi mthar/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /slar yang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas 'bar ba'i dbus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag bskyed ji 'dra ba bzhin bskyed pa'i mthar rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de rnams la snga ma bzhin du 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis byon zan phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī zhes kun la sbyar la/ phyi'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// de nas rdzas rnams snga ma'i tshul gyis 'di nyid kyi sngags kyis dbul zhing*/ spel tshig rnams sngar bzhin byas nas mthar yang*/ mar dgang blugs bdun phul la/ slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma'ang phul la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha dmigs pa la mchod cing bstod nas bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs par phul ba'i mtha' mar dgang blugs bdun phul nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma/ om̐ ag+na ye na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gri h+ne daṃ ba li ta ye swā hā/

zhes gsum mam/ bdun gyis phul nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol gdab bo/ /gtor ma gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo/ /de nas oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad nas/ lhag ma'i bar gyi cho ga rdzogs par byas la/ smon lam rgya chen po btab nas/ bdag gi gnas gsum bsrungs te/ thal ba chu bo la sogs par dor la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas nas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa la gnas par bya'o/ /'di ltar rtag tu byas na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das ba'i dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rje sa skya pa'i man ngag las byung ba'i dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'di ni go go chen gyis bskul nas/ 'phags pas sa mo sbrul gyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po la shang tor sbyar ba'o || || ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos grub rin chen mi zad gter/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mar btud nas | | de yi byin rlabs rgya mtsho yis/ /'byor par bya phyir 'dir bshad bya/ / chos kyi tshul 'di la zhugs shing 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zagabyin rlabs dang dngos grub don du gnyer bas/ dus bzang po la gnas dben zhing yid du 'ong bar/ dri bzang po dang ba byung gis byugs pa'i gzhi tshon dmar pos yongs su bsgyur ba la/ re kha dkar pos phyi'i mu khyud dang bcas pa'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris pa'i steng du/ ka pā la bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba'i chang gis yongs su bkang ba bzhag nas/ de'i steng du sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor dpe'u ris bzhin gser gyi thur mas bris pa'i dbus su/

dri ma med pa'i ting lo chung ngu bzhag pa'i steng du dar dmar po la sogs pa'i dar khang mdzes par phub pa'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ shin tu zhim pa'i bza' ba dang*/ btung ba dang*/ 'bras bu la sogs pas yongs su bskor zhing gtor ma gsum dang*/ nang mchod la sogs pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs bzhin bshams shing*/ gzungs thag gis dkris pa'i rdo rje dang dung chos dang bcas pa'i bum pa bcud rnams kyis bkang ba gcig kyang bshams la/ zhu ba 'bul ba nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo ltar bya'o | | de nas suṃ bha' ི sngags brjod cing nang mchod kyis sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la gtor te bsangs nas/ swa bhā was stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung ram̐ las me lam̐ las sa sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du/ kam̐ las thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ e'i yi ge gnyis brtsegs pa las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi yi ge dmigs pa rnams las 'od zer phar 'phros/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + sems can gyi don byas ) tshur 'dus ¡Ã gcig tu 'dres pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· yongs su gyur pa ) las byung ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas/ go cha dgod pa dang ye shes pa spyan drangs nas | mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar/ tshogs 'khor gyi skabs bzhin bya'o/

/de nas bum pa sum̐ bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa bskyed pa'i nang du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed nas ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas pa la phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas nas gzungs thag bzung ste/ sngags gzungs thag la brten nas bum pa'i nang du song bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs bskul nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ rje btsun ma'i sngags gang grub pa dang*/ suṃ bha'i sngags gang grub pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ dung chos kyi chu ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bum par ) blugs pas lha'i sku yang 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bsdad nas/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba bdag la rtse gcig tu dgongs pa mngon sum ltar dmigs la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma'i rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ¡Ã mas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ma nyid kyis ) mdzad par bsam zhing*/ gdong g.yogs bcing*/ me tog phreng ba blang*/ bum pa'i chus bsangs/ om̐ āḥ hūm̐

| zhes brjod cing nang mchod myangs pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bor bsams nas/ rje btsun mas snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ gsang bar gdams par mdzad par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi | su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sing+ngh-i badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes gsungs shing byin gyis brlabs nas/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor ¡Ã du ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dam pa ru ) ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ ) zhes brjod da | | de nas rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag dkyil 'khor du bcug par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod do/ /de nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rjes su zlo bar bsam zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas khyad par du sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa bshags par bya/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma ma mchis pa nas | las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa ni dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ khyad par du bla ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha la ma gus pa dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma la ma brtson pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la g.yel ba la sogs pa sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang nyes pa dang*/ ltung ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang gcod cing bsdam lags so/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams blang ba'i bsam pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang | | dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol | | bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang

| | sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum | | sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung | | rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ / pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi | | byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas | | sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod pas rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig dang sdom pa blang ngo*/ /de nas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams blang ba'i bsam pas/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ ) sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / he ru ka dpal sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/

/ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gzung*/ / ¡Ã zhes ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ces pas yang lan ) lan gsum brjod pas blang ngo*/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad gang zhing khyab pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas 'od 'dus pa lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du bam̐ gyi yi ge sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba zhig tu gyur nas/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od 'jig rten ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + gyi khams ) thams cad la phog pas ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + snod yongs su dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ ) rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas 'od tshur 'dus te rang la thim pas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas/ go cha bcing ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la/ slob dpon khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor gyi ting lo spar la/ de rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang | ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa de nyid kyi thugs kar/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad dang mnyam par gyur pa/ rje btsun ma nyid kyis bdag gi khar bcug par bsam zhing*/ mid pas mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dang lus kyi dbus su yar khug mar khug mang du byas nas ) / lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ dang 'dres pa las byung ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsal bar bskyed la/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas gar mdzad/ nang gi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang*/ phyi'i lha mo'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor bar bsam mo/ /de'i tshe mdun gyi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rje btsun ) rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang | sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sngags kyi sgra drag tu bsgrags pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ) thams cad bskul nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur pa bdag la thim pas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ sgrub pa'i grogs rnams kyis gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra byed du gzhug go /de nas rje btsun mas bdag gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par byas par bsam/ ye shes bab pa las byung ba'i nyams myong ma brjed par bskyang*/ de nas me tog phreng ba rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ /zhes brjod nas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dbul/ phreng ba de sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas | rje btsun mas bdag gi spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ oṃ pra ti gri h+na s+t+wa mi maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la om̐/ zhes gsung bar bsam zhing spyi bor blang*/ de nas oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ pa hrīḥphaiṃ/ zhes gsung zhing gdong g.yogs phye nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bsams shing dngos su blta'o/ /'jug pa'o/ /de nas dbang blang pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba/ / 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar mkha' spyod ma dpal gtso/ /de ni bdag la'ang deng mdzod cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur dmigs pa'i mdun du rin po che'i khri'i steng du/

rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs pa'i steng du gdugs dang*/ sa dang nam mkha' thams cad mchod pas gang bas bdag la mchod par bsam/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha 'phros pas so sos dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad/ khyad par lha mo nyid rigs lnga dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bas spyi bo nas blugs shing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis | | de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñcā mi/ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñcā hūm̐/ zhes mgrin gcig tu gsung zhing dbang bskur bar bsam/ dngos su yang gtor bas spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ spyi gtsug tu rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ de nas rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes gsung bar bsam zhing me tog gtor nas/ rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /de nas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bgrang phreng bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas bdag gi snying ga'i bam̐ gyi mtha' mar g.yon skor du bkod pas/ rje btsun ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs bdag la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ gsang sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/

/bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum gsungs nas/ sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon blangs la/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du byugs pas sku'i dngos grub thams cad 'grub par bsgom zhing*/ lus kyi dri ma dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam du bsam mo/ /bum pa'i dbang ngo*// //de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar maṇ+ḍal gyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa/ rje btsun ma nyid kyis bdag gi kha'i sgor byin par bsam zhing*/ dngos su 'thungs pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam zhing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// // de nas yang g.yon pa'i srin lag gis san+dhu ra'i rdul tshon blangs te/ rang gi gsang gnas dang*/ lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ skra mtshams rnams su reg pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le bdag gi bha ga nas zhugs nas/ lus thams cad la khyab pas rim pa bzhin ye shes kyi dga' ba bzhi skyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam mo/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// //de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid ltos/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgoms | | zhes chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ngo sprad nas/ rang nyid kyang stong pa nyid kyi ngang la sems mnyam par bzhag go /de nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi pa thob snyam du bsams nas/ dbang thams cad gnang ba'i bka' drin gyi lan du/
