lus longs spyod thams cad yid kyis phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na | khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ tshogs la longs spyod pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol nas bdag nyid bsrung pa'i bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzhin bya'o/ /bye brag tu sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ sin+dhur rnams ni za ma tog la sogs par legs par bzung la/ phyis kyi'ang rdul tshon la ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + sogs pa ) bsre bar bya'o/ /tshul de ltar rtag tu byas na/ sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang | bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/ tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs nas myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ / mkha' spyod dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blang ba'i// tshul 'di zab mo'i snying po ste/ /gsang ba las kyang gsang ba yin/ /de ltar mod kyis tshul 'di la/ /dad cing shes rab rab gsal ba/ /go go chen gyis gsol btab nas/ /sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i dpal thob nas/ /gnyis su med par rol par shog /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + sun+dhu ra'i ) dkyil 'khor du ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bdag nyid ) 'jug cing*/ dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa blang ba'i cho ga 'di ni/ lcags pho rta'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin par shang to'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas sd-ig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas/

sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa sel bar 'dod pas me dang*/ til dang*/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa ¡Ã mngon du byas shing ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bsham nas ) / skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ me'i phung po dang mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs | stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa'i thab khung dkar po zlum po'i dbus su/ ram̐ las ye shes kyi me 'bar bar bskyed nas/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod nas/ byin gyis brlab | mchod rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med par bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab/ ¡Ã de nas thab kyi nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nas me'i dbus su ) hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal gdangs shing rus pa dang rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bskyed la/ gnas gsum du/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas spyan drangs pa la me tog la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du

gsol | zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zh-ing ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la | oṃ badz+ra ḍā kā ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod / / ces pas bstod nas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + gsol ba btab pa ni ) / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gros bdag gi sdig pa dang | sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad snying gar bsdus pa kam̐ gi rnam pas sna sgo nas thon pa til la thim pas/ mi'i gzugs rid pa dang*/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du phul ba bdud rtsir gyur pa gsol bas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing til

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + mtheb srin gyis blangs te ) dbul/ thog ma dang mtha' mar bha smiṃ ku ru/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas pas dbul/ mthar snga ma bzhin du mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs kyis ) bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ thal ba chu bor dor bas chu la gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du 'gyur ro/ /tshul 'di nyid gzhan gyi don ¡Ã la dmigs te/ byas pas gzhan gyi don du yang 'gyur ro / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· du byas kyang phan yon dpag tu med pa yod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ) /za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga chos rje sa skya ¡Ã pa'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· paṇ+ḍi ta'i ) gdams pa 'phags pas yi ger bkod nas rgyal bu jim gyim la phul ba'o// //༄༅/ /sgyu ma bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i thabs tshul gyis/ /srid pa'i sgyu ma las grol nas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba gang brnyes pa'i/ / sgyu ma che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol pa bzhin/ /rdo rje slob dpon rnam rol pas/ /slob ma bde la rol byed pa'i/ /dbang bskur rnam par rol pa bshad/ /slob dpon dang ni slob ma nyid/ /phan tshun mtshan nyid ldan rig nas/ /gnas dus yo byad phun tshogs pas/ /dbang bskur ba yi cho ga brtsam | | sngon du 'gro dang lhag gnas dang*/ /dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi'i bya ba dang | | de bzhin mjug gi cho ga ste/ /rnam pa bzhis ni yang dag bsdus/ / de'ang ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la/

sngags kyi lam gyis mchog gi byang chub don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams kyis/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du song bas/ byang chub kyi bar gyi bla ma nyid du gsol ba btab nas/ de la dbang blang ba'i blos/ khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan nas skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag ni gnang bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo/ /bla mas kyang yo byad dang nus pa dris nas/ nus shing 'byor par khas len na/ kho bos ji ltar nus pa'i rjes su gzung gis/ khyod kyis kyang bag yod par byos shig ces bsgos nas/ sngon chad lam la ma zhugs na/ ji ltar spro ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa byin nas so so'i bslab bya'ang bstan la slob tu gzhug go /de nas slob ma la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la/ na mas sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gri h+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin la/ ting lo dang chang bu rngan par sbyin zhing sum+bha'i sngags kyis bsdigs nas gu gul gyis bdugayungs dkar gyis brab/ drag po'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bskrad do/ /de nas de'i sdig pa kam̐ gi rnam pas phyung zhing til la bstim pas/ ye shes kyi me dang rgya mtshor dmigs pa'i me dang chur dor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sdig pa sbyang ngo*/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ gis/ mngon par bsngags pa'i chus bag chags kyi dri ma bkrus nas gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung ngo*/ /slob ma gzung ba'o/ /de nas bsnyen pa'i yo byad slob mas sbyar nas bum pa la brten pa lha sta gon ltar ram/ ma brten pa bskyed rim ltar dngos sam rmi lam du gnang ba thob kyi bar ram/

gtso bo la 'bum phrag brgyad dang*/ 'khor la khri phrag brgyad kyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'o// //de nas dur khrod dam/ chu 'gram mam/ bas mtha' la sogs pa dben zhing nyams dga' la 'tshe ba med cing yo byad phun sum tshogs pa kha dog dang dbyibs dang mtshan ma bzang po dang ldan pa dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir 'os par shes pa dang*/ thog mar mngon pa las bslangs nas lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la legs par byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su/ me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa/ skad cig gis dkyil 'khor rdzogs par mos par yongs rdzogs su bsgrubs nas/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod la/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bde gshegs thams cad bdag la dgongs/ khyed rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni/ / slob ma rnams la phan phyir du/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya yi/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bri bar 'tshal/ /bdag la byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis brlab par bsgoms nas gshegs su gsol te tshom bu rnams bsdu ba'o/ /gnang ba zhu ba'o/ /de nas de nyid du slar yang me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du lam̐ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa phyogs skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag gis bskor ba bskyed nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa bon gyi 'od dang lag pa g.yas pa sa la lan gsum bsnun pas rang bzhin du gnas pa bkug nas bstim ste dbang bskur nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyas btab pa la/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/

/ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag la slob ma che ge mo zhes bya bas bskul nas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod pa'i phyir phyogs 'dir/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas dbang bskur bar bgyid par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab nas*/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag dang bcas pa la'ang gtor ma byin nas/ sa phyogs 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ / gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa/ /rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang*/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pas | khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ / ces lan gsum brjod pas de dag thams cad kyis ji ltar dga' ba byos shig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim pa dang*/ so so'i gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /mi mngon pa las bslang ba ste sa bslang ba'o/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba gsum gsum lto 'phye'i mgo /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang*/ /bltas te g.yon pa'i zur gyis nyal/ /pus mo lto ba rked tsam du/ / dngos grub rjes mthun lto nas brko /zhes pa'i tshul gyis sol ba dang gseg ma dang gyo mo dang rus pa la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyungs nas/ sman dang 'bru dang rin po che dang bcas pa'i sa brnyan bzang pos bkang la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chus dran zhing 'thas par brdungs te dbus mtho zhing shar dang byang gzhol ba me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa'i sa stegs ji ltar rigs pa bya'o/

/brkor mi rung ba la ni/ oṃ ha na ha na kro ngha hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sngags kyis zug rngu sbyangs nas sa brnyan bzang po'i sa stegs brtsigs pas rung ba nyid do/ /zug rngu sbyang ba'o/ /de nas slob dpon ¡Ã gyis ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dkyil 'khor gyi ) dbus su kha shar du phyogs te 'dug la/ bhu khaṃ dang swa bhā was sa phyogs stong par bsgoms nas hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bskyed la/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i steng du pam̐ dang ram̐ las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis byin gyis brlabs te | de'i dbus su rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka nas phur bu dang tho ba 'dzin pa'i khro bo'i tshogs du ma spros pas phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du bkug la dkar po'i phyogs rnams lam la bkod cing*/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btab nas/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+tāṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra.ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nan kā ya wāka tsit+ta/ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas rdo rje tho bas brdung bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra badz+ra kī la ya/ ā' ko ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus thal ba'i phung por gyur zhing sems kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas/ khro bo rnams rdo rje'i ra ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas srung ba'i las mdzad par bsam mo/ /bgegs sbyang ba ste sa sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas phyogs bzhir 'khod pa'i las kyi slob ma dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor lngas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms nas mthar lha so so'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas slob dpon ting nge 'dzin las bslang ba'i phyir/

phyogs bzhi'i slob mas rim pa bzhin | | de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas | | chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol | | mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnams spangs pa/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon ting nge 'dzin las langs te | oṃ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭhas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i he ru kar dmigs pa'i mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan par dmigs nas g.yon nas g.yas dang*/ g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs rnams tshar gcad pa dang rjes su gzung ba byas nas rkang mthil a las sna tshogs rdo rje bltas te khro bo'i 'gying btsal pa lan gsum byas nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song la/ hūm̐ song shig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bdag nyid gtso/ /bde chen ye shes las byung ba'i/ /nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis | | mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*/ /zhig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ / de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas bka' bsgos nas | sum+bha'i sngags drag tu brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad nas/ shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lho ru g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga

byang du zlum po la sogs pa'i rkang stabs dang goms stabs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug kun tu bcags pas rkang rjes rnams sna tshogs rdo rje gyur par bltas la/ slar yang dbus su 'khod de/ 'dug stangs lag stangs bzhin gyi 'gyur tshul ngag gi 'dren pa rnams ji skad bshad pa'i tshul rnams byas pas kyang byin gyis brlab cing gzung ngo*/ /sa gzung ba'o// //slar yang bgegs mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par dmigs nas sngar bshad pa'i cho gas phyogs mtshams rnams su rdo rje phur bu yang gdab bo/ /sa gzung ba ste sa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas lha sta gon la 'jug pa ni phyem red kyi tshe nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsags shing bshams la sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor mas der lhags pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs tshim par byas nas snod du mi rung ba rnams bskrad la las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab ste yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms la sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang ci rigs par bya'o/ /de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsang zhing sbyangs nas bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su me tog tshom bu bkod la/ sa'i lha mo'i cho ga snga ma ji lta ba bzhin du byas te sa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ltar tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas mchod pa'i skabs ltar phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas rdo rje dril bu spos dang bcas pa 'dzin pas/ he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yang dag ldan/ /phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis sdig pa 'jig byed pa'i

| | dkyil 'khor nangs par 'dri 'tshal te/ /rjes su brtse bas dgongs nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas bum pa bsang zhing sbyangs nas pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bhūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa drug gam gnyis bshams ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + pa bzhin bskyed ) la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par mngon byang las gtso bo dang bum pa gzhan bzhir 'khor rnams mngal nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis bskyed pa'am/ yang na de nyid du thams cad bskyed do/ /las thams cad pa'i bum par hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ khro bo phyag gnyis pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dmigs la/ thams cad la rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'i bar du bya ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la ni don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'o/ /de nas mchod cing bstod nas/ de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song ba lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas dgyes shing dbang du gyur pas kha dog dmar por gyur nas/ sku'i cha thams cad las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing lha lnga'i sngags sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pa bzlas nas slar yang mchod cing bstod de dung chos kyi chu blugs pas thams cad 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chur blta'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /gzhan yang slob ma la nye bar mkho bo'i yo byad kun yi ge gsum las grub pa'i rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo/ /yo byad lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir/

tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad nas lhag ma'i gtor ma byas la gsang ba'i rdzas dang lha rnams mi mngon par bya ba ni bar skabs kyi bya ba'o// // de nas kha dang gdong dag par bkrus pa'i slob ma rnams phyag 'tshal zhing maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa rnams la/sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*/ /dkyil 'khor

'dir ni gzhug bya ste// bsod nams 'dod pas 'di las gzhan/ /bdag gzhan 'jig rten pha rol gnyer | | dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces brjod nas don bshad de/ snying rje chen po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang don du gnyer ba'i yid dang ldan par byas pa rnams 'od kyi tshul gyis slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs pa thugs ka'i ye shes kyi mes sbyangs te yum gyi mkhar byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par babs pa he ru kar gyur pa las ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas te/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa spros nas so so'i gnas su dgod do/ /de ltar nang gi dbang gis sbyangs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis gong du phul ba'i maṇ+ḍal dbang gi yon du dmigs la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum du khyad par can gyi don du zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa rnams la/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya | | sangs rgyas dus gsum las 'das pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can | | mnyam nyid ye shes thob pa ni/ /rdo rje sngags rab bsgoms pas so/ / gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /he ru ka dpal sbyor ba yis/

/bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod nas don bshad pas gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang sdom pa gzung ba'i phyir/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag gis ni/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*/ /chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dus gsum bde bshegs thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ / ma lus bzhugs pa 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bde gshegs bla med sangs rgyas rnams | | bdag la gzigs nas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gis 'di nyid nas bzung nas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang | | yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi | | rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ / nyin re zhing ni lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum | | dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/

/sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang*/ / rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ / sangs rgyas myur du bsgrub bya ste/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug go /yang na sta gon gyi skabs su rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed tsam byas nas/ sdom pa gzung ba rgyas par dngos gzhi'i skabs su mdzad de 'di ni mdzes par mthong ngo*/ /de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing yi ge gsum las byung ba'i 'khor lo dang | pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje/ sa bon so sos mtshan pa bskyed nas de las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mtshan ma'i rnam pa spyan drangs pa bstim pas rgyas btab cing byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa la me tog la sogs pas mchod do/ /de nas skal ba dang dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos khye ma med par byugs par me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod de/ sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i so shing*/ oṃ dzi hwa/ badz+ra saṃ bar+ngha ni'i sngags kyis byin pa thal mo sbyar bas blangs nas/ so'i dri ma bsal nas 'chos la sdig pa thams cad skyug pa'i bsam pas kha shar ram byang du bltas te/ 'dor du bcug pa'i rtse mo shar du phyogs na zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu gter/ mtshams su dngos grub phra mo/ bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par lung bstan to// //de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus skyor chu sbyin zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shung+ngha sarba dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan ā pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces brjod de 'thung du bcug pas nang gi dri ma sbyong ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa'i srung skud byin gyis brlabs pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon pa dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas par bcings nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag | u dum+bā ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*/ /sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste/ /gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /bla na med pa byed par nus// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o// dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*/ /de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so/ /zhes brjod pa'i don bshad la spro ba mi nyams par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags pa'i ku sha nghīḥdang has lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du byin pa sngas dang stan du bcug nas gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu phab ste rnam par rtog pa spangs nas lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas nyal du bcug la rmi lam mthong ba nangs par smros shig ces bsgos nas btang la/ nangs par rmi lam brjod pa'i tshe bgegs dang ldan par rig na drag po'i sbyin sreg gam khro bo'i sngags dang rnal 'byor gyis sbyang ba dang sdig pa dang bar chad dang ldan pa la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gam spyan gyi rnal 'byor gyis sbyang zhing bzang po mthong na spro ba bskyed do// slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams rang gi gnas su dong ba'i mthar | tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod nas/ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags dang phyag rgyas nam mkha' la bteg ste de nyid du bzhugs su gsol nas mgron gshegs su gsol te gtor ma btang la/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o/ /nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldang ngo*/

/lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas tho rangs kyi cha la man ngag bzhin brkyang ba dang bskor ba'i las kyi thig gis cha rnam par phye nas ji ltar 'byor pa'i rdul tshon drang ba bde zhing kha dog bzang ba bsgrubs pa rnams kyi dkar po la om̐ bris la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang*/ sngon po la hūm̐/ ser po la traṃ/ dmar po la hrīḥ ljang gu la āḥbris pa rnams shar nas rim pa bzhin bkod la thig skud sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha/ chur dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur gyi tshad dang ldan pa so so'ang lnga sgril du bya zhing*/ 'jur mdud dang sbom phra dang ring thung gi nyes pa dang bral ba kha dog lngas bsgyur ba rnams tshon so so'i steng du bzhag pa'i khor yug tu mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas rang gi chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 338PAGE 339 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
